services.name: Agentic AI Architecture & Development
services.seoTitle: Agentic AI Development Company in India
services.short: We architect and build AI agents that plan, use your tools and complete multi-step work — safely, measurably, in production.

hero.title: Agentic AI, architected for production
hero.promise: Chatbots answer questions. Agents get work done: they plan, call your systems, check their own output and hand over to a person when they should. Our founders and in-house AI engineers design and build agentic systems for any business — from a first use case to a governed, multi-agent platform.

problems: An AI demo that impressed everyone but never made it to production
Multi-step work — triage, research, data entry, follow-ups — still done by hand across five tools
No clear answer to 'what happens when the agent gets it wrong?'
LLM costs and latency nobody is measuring
Teams experimenting with AI in silos, with no shared architecture or guardrails

deliverables.title: Agentic architecture & strategy
deliverables.body: Use-case selection, autonomy levels, build-vs-buy and a reference architecture your teams can reuse.

deliverables.title: Single & multi-agent systems
deliverables.body: Planner–executor and supervisor patterns, specialist agents and orchestration with LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK or the Claude Agent SDK.

deliverables.title: Tool use & system integration
deliverables.body: Agents that act through your APIs, databases, ERP, CRM, email and WhatsApp — with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers where they fit.

deliverables.title: Memory & knowledge (RAG)
deliverables.body: Retrieval over your documents and data, short- and long-term agent memory, and answers that cite their source.

deliverables.title: Guardrails & human-in-the-loop
deliverables.body: Permissions per tool, approval steps for money and customer-facing actions, input/output filtering and full audit trails.

deliverables.title: Evaluation, observability & cost control
deliverables.body: Test suites for agent behaviour, tracing of every step, and cost and latency tracked per task — so you know it works before you scale it.

deliverables.title: Agentic features in your product
deliverables.body: For SaaS companies and startups: agents built into your product, designed for multi-tenant scale.

deliverables.title: Team enablement
deliverables.body: Architecture reviews, pairing and playbooks so your own engineers can build the next agent.

useCases.title: AI agent for invoice processing
useCases.body: Reads invoices and POs from email, matches them against orders in your ERP, flags mismatches and queues clean ones for one-click approval.

useCases.title: Enquiry triage and follow-up agent
useCases.body: Classifies inbound leads from web, email and WhatsApp, enriches them from your CRM, drafts the reply and books the follow-up.

useCases.title: Research and reporting agent
useCases.body: Pulls data from several internal systems, compiles the weekly report and explains what changed, with links to every source.

useCases.title: Support resolution agent
useCases.body: Looks up orders, tickets and policies, resolves routine cases end to end and escalates the rest to a person with full context.

useCases.title: Multi-agent operations workflow
useCases.body: A supervisor agent coordinating specialist agents for intake, checks and updates, with human approval on every money or customer action.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?
faqs.a: A chatbot answers. An agent pursues a goal: it plans steps, calls tools and systems, checks results and decides what to do next — within limits you set.

faqs.q: Is agentic AI only for large companies?
faqs.a: No. Most first agents we scope automate one well-understood workflow for an SME or startup, such as triaging enquiries, processing documents or preparing follow-ups, and are measured against one KPI.

faqs.q: How do you stop an agent doing something it shouldn't?
faqs.a: Each agent gets only the tools and permissions it needs. Actions that touch money, customers or records go through human approval, every step is logged, and behaviour is tested against an evaluation suite before release.

faqs.q: Which models and frameworks do you use?
faqs.a: Whatever fits the job and your constraints — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI and open models such as Llama, orchestrated with LangGraph or the vendor agent SDKs. We design so you can switch models later.

faqs.q: Do you have AI engineers, or is this outsourced?
faqs.a: Our founders lead agentic architecture personally and we have AI engineers in-house who build and run the systems.

faqs.q: How do we start with AI without a big budget?
faqs.a: With an AI Opportunity Audit: one or two sessions and a written report naming your top three use cases, expected impact, cost and the data each one needs. If one is worth doing, we run a fixed-scope 4–6 week pilot measured against a business KPI.

Your data stays yours. We use test or consented data for demos, keep a human in the loop for anything customer-facing or money-related, and log AI outputs for audit. For student and personal data we design to India's DPDP Act.
Any AI can. That is why money, admissions and customer-facing replies go through human review, and why every pilot is measured before it is scaled.
